skill.name: orca-per-workspace-env
skill.description: Guides setup, review, debugging, and validation of Orca recipes that create disposable environments for individual workspaces.
skill.summary: Configure and troubleshoot disposable Orca environments for each workspace.
skill.author: stablyai

security_audit.summary: All 17 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown formatting or prose references to command shells. However, executable selection from an environment variable and runtime loading of unaudited guidance create high-risk trust boundaries.

remediation.issue: ORCA_CLI_COMMAND controls the executable without validation.
remediation.suggestion: Require an absolute path, reject arguments and shell syntax, and verify the executable belongs to an approved Orca installation.

remediation.issue: The audited stub loads operational instructions dynamically.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle the complete guide with the skill or cryptographically pin and verify the retrieved guide before following it.

content.value_statement: Per-workspace environment recipes can fail because CLI selection and provider lifecycle details vary. This skill loads Orca guidance matched to the active version.
actual_capabilities: Resolves the appropriate Orca executable for the current session context.
Loads version-matched guidance through the Orca skills command.
Guides repairs to environmentRecipes entries in orca.yaml.
Helps diagnose Orca recipe doctor failures.
Defines clear stop conditions when the selected executable fails.
limitations: The stub does not contain the complete environment recipe workflow.
It requires an available Orca executable and dynamically loaded guidance.
It does not cover ordinary worktree or workspace creation.
Available commands depend on the installed Orca version.

best_practices: Resolve the Orca executable once and reuse it throughout the session.
Prefer structured command output when the installed CLI supports it.
Stop and report exact errors instead of switching silently to another Orca build.
anti_patterns: Do not run bare orca on Linux outside an Orca-managed terminal.
Do not execute the ORCA placeholder literally or store it as a shell variable.
Do not guess unsupported commands, flags, or recipe fields.

faq.question: What is a per-workspace environment?
faq.answer: It is a disposable runtime that Orca creates separately for each workspace.

faq.question: Which environment providers are supported?
faq.answer: The description covers cloud sandboxes, virtual machines, SSH hosts, and local containers. Exact support depends on the loaded guide.

faq.question: Does this skill create ordinary worktrees?
faq.answer: No. Use the separate orca-cli skill for workspace and worktree creation without environment recipes.

faq.question: Why should I avoid bare orca on Linux?
faq.answer: Outside managed terminals, that name can resolve to the GNOME Orca screen reader instead of the intended CLI.

faq.question: What happens when the selected executable fails?
faq.answer: Report the exact error and stop. Switching executables can silently target a different Orca build.

faq.question: Can the skill use commands missing from the guide?
faq.answer: Use CLI help for read-only discovery. Do not guess commands or flags that the guide does not cover.
